comments.used_for: inherited cover-route statement and same-port block claim
comments.excerpt: At fresh stage s, a port transition p -> q changes the physical cover class by rho_(s,p) rho_(s,q). Every other stage fixes its fresh eight-space E_s. A product returning to the original cover class therefore forces each stage factor to fix E_s; for the actual 112 ports this happens exactly when p=q. We checked all 50,176 ordered stage/port pairs for the five-call m41 geometry. Since the pure side matrix has M_pp=0 and K_pp=1, the same-cover/same-port block of the proposed five-word is [[1,0],[131/144,1]], rather than the required [[0,-1],[1,0]].
